meaning:
ἀναπολόγητος, -ον
(ἀπολογεόμαι),
without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): Rom.1:20 2:1.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power…
